name: Publish browser engine
# GITHUB_TOKEN-created releases suppress release events. Resolve only the
# published tag from a completed main run; no fork head is executed here.
on: # zizmor: ignore[dangerous-triggers]
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI/CD Pipeline"]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches-ignore: ['e2e/**']
    paths:
      - "js/**"
      - "data/seed/**"
      - "packages/formal-ai-engine/**"
      - "package.json"
      - "bun.lock"
      - ".github/workflows/publish-engine.yml"
      - "scripts/resolve-package-release.mjs"
      - "scripts/publish-browser-engine.mjs"
      - "scripts/generate-web-distribution.py"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Run package checks without publication
        type: choice
        options: [checks]
        default: checks
      pull-request:
        description: Pull request whose package checks were dispatched
        type: string
        default: ''
      publish:
        description: Publish the selected stable release (main only)
        type: boolean
        default: false
      tag:
        description: Published release tag (empty selects the latest)
        type: string
        default: ''
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: package-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  resolve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'workflow_run' ||
      (github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.event.workflow_run.conclusion != 'cancelled' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.conclusion != 'skipped')
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
      publish: ${{ steps.release.outputs.publish }}
      build: ${{ steps.release.outputs.build }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24.x'
      - name: Resolve the published package release
        id: release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          REFERENCE: ${{ github.ref }}
          PUBLISH: ${{ inputs.publish }}
          INPUT_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
          RUN_HEAD: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          RUN_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
          RUN_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name }}
          RUN_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: node scripts/resolve-package-release.mjs
  package:
    needs: resolve
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.resolve.outputs.build == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Select the resolved release tag
        if: needs.resolve.outputs.tag != ''
        env:
          PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 1
          git fetch origin "refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG:refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG"
          git checkout --detach "refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24.x'
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Prepare web and engine artifacts
        run: |
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          bun run build:web
      - name: Package the engine
        working-directory: packages/formal-ai-engine
        run: npm pack --ignore-scripts
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: formal-ai-engine
          path: packages/formal-ai-engine/*.tgz
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Attach installable engine package to the release
        if: needs.resolve.outputs.publish == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.tag }}
        run: gh release upload "$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG" packages/formal-ai-engine/*.tgz --clobber
      - name: Publish with provenance
        if: needs.resolve.outputs.publish == 'true'
        working-directory: packages/formal-ai-engine
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING: ${{ vars.FORMAL_AI_NPM_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$NODE_AUTH_TOKEN" ] && [ "$NPM_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING" != "true" ]; then
            echo "::notice::npm publication is not configured; the installable tarball is attached to the release"
            exit 0
          fi
          node ../../scripts/publish-browser-engine.mjs
